start: Linked to a gym with enough timed check-ins over past weeks; gym open now

user_sees: Busy card: 'Quiet right now' / 'About as busy as usual' / 'Busier than usual right now', and 'About <n> people checked in during the last 90 minutes' when 5 or more
must_not: A level shown while the gym is still learning, or a count under 5

user_sees: 'Quietest later today: <h> to <h>' and 'From check-ins at your gym over the last <n> weeks. No names are shown.'
must_not: '1 weeks', or a quiet stretch in an hour that has already started

steps.action: Pick another day on the card
user_sees: 'Quietest on <Day>: <h> to <h>' and bars for that day
must_not: Bars that do not line up between days

start: Gym's own hours say closed now (night or a holiday like Diwali) while check-ins still show a level

user_sees: 'Closed right now' and no people count
must_not: 'Busier than usual right now' on a holiday the gym set as closed

user_sees: A fresh ask at once
must_not: Two asks stacked or the card flickering away

start: New gym with too few check-ins, or a server without the busy function

user_sees: No busy card at all
must_not: An empty card, a guess, or an error message

steps.action: Go offline for over 30 minutes and look again
user_sees: The card hides (an old answer is not 'right now')
must_not: A stale level shown as current

start: Busy card showed; member leaves the gym or the gym turns something off

steps.action: Leave the gym and open the Gym tab
user_sees: No busy card (nothing is kept on the phone)
must_not: The old gym's busy level still showing

user_sees: The card returns after the next ask
must_not: The card never returning until the app restarts

start: Any linked member opens the busy card

user_sees: Only gym-level levels and a rounded count; 'No names are shown.'
must_not: Any name, member id or time of a single person's visit
